The draw/display over other apps' permission allows the app to see all the activity performed on other apps. The other way to put it: if you allow an app to draw over other apps, then that app may interfere with other apps. It can see what you are doing on your phone, what you are typing, and even record a video!!!

Problem: Grab Driver App thought I've Jailbreak/Rooted my phone, right after latest update (11 March 2019). App version: 5.66.0 Build 476 . Lowest is 1 star, so I'm only giving 1 star for online Grab Support team because they couldn't even point me to the right direction (appreciate them taking time to help me out though). They asked me to wait for 24 hours for technical team to reply, there's no one able to pin point or didn't have any slightest clue of what was causing the Grab Driver app auto logout after few seconds of logging in. I drive full time, so each 24 hours to me, is a few hundred Ringgit lost. Went to local Grab Driver support office, they were helpful and gave me some ideas on what to try - 2 stars for them. I spent almost ONE HOUR to uninstall those apps one by one. In my case, I found out this app called " Native Clipboard Manager " was requesting for permission to use the accessibility's feature, uninstalling that app solved the issue! Solution: So drivers, for similar problems, check if there's any other similar apps that require special permissions to use the accessibility features in your device, or app that modifies the Android system itself. Hope it helps!

Lately grab has reduced the hourly Guarentee incentives by a significant amount, forcing drivers to turn on Auto Accept to earn incentives and introducing Timeout feature for those that ignore jobs more than a few times in a row. Grab is only concern about making money at the expense of its drivers who are at the highest risk to harm. There have been cases of robbery and even a driver was murdered by passenger in Malaysia. Grab has exhibit an extreme lack of urgency in vetting real passengers with real name and photo for identification. Please support other e hailing application like mycar, quolo, mula, dacsee etc so that grab will not be a lackadaisical monopoly. Without drivers they will be no grab.

Usually, riders requests came in before driver have the time to turn off the app after drop off, affecting driver's cr. to quite a certain degree. 5. Grabshare fares should be at least RM 10 unless there are other riders along the way . If not, with only 1 passenger below Rm 10, it will not be worth it for drivers as Grabshare has a lower fare. 6. In view of traffic jams in city like KL, fares should be higher than at present, for, with daily very heavy traffic jams, it usually is not be adequate for drivers to pickup around town areas at peak hours resulting in numerous cancelations. Please keep in mind that Grab car fares are much more cheaper than taxis during peak hours and it usually is not worth it for Grab Drivers to be caught in city traffic jams (especially for short trips), even with Hourly Guarantee, and no addition to fares, unlike taxis, which has a runninng meter. 7. Last but not least, thank you for doing this review and trying to make things better for us drivers.
